					top_liege != this
					is_pool_character = no
					has_royal_court = no
					exists = liege.liege
					exists = liege.liege.liege
					exists = liege.liege.liege.liege
					liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege.liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege.liege.liege = {
						has_royal_court = yes
						has_dlc_feature = royal_court
						has_same_court_language = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = 5
			desc = aeluran_mm_r34
		}
	}

	# 35: foreign_realm_court_language_spoken_interaction_reason
	if = {
		limit = {

				has_royal_court = yes
				has_dlc_feature = royal_court
				knows_court_language_of = this
			}
			scope:actor.top_liege != scope:recipient.top_liege
			OR = {
				AND = {
					scope:recipient = {
						has_royal_court = yes
						has_dlc_feature = royal_court
					}
					scope:actor = { 
						has_same_court_language = scope:recipient
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = { 
					top_liege != this
					is_pool_character = no
					has_royal_court = no
					liege ?= {
						has_royal_court = yes
						has_dlc_feature = royal_court
						has_same_court_language = scope:actor
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = { 
					top_liege != this
					is_pool_character = no
					has_royal_court = no
					exists = liege.liege
					liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege = {
						has_royal_court = yes
						has_dlc_feature = royal_court
						has_same_court_language = scope:actor
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = { 
					top_liege != this
					is_pool_character = no
					has_royal_court = no
					exists = liege.liege
					exists = liege.liege.liege
					liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege.liege = {
						has_royal_court = yes
						has_dlc_feature = royal_court
						has_same_court_language = scope:actor
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = { 
					top_liege != this
					is_pool_character = no
					has_royal_court = no
					exists = liege.liege
					exists = liege.liege.liege
					exists = liege.liege.liege.liege
					liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}

						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege.liege = {
						top_liege != this
						has_royal_court = no
					}
					liege.liege.liege.liege = {
						has_royal_court = yes

	# 37: oath_of_alliances_marriage_acceptance_value
	if = {

				is_allied_to = scope:actor

			scope:actor = {
				has_character_modifier = oath_of_alliances
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = 10
			desc = aeluran_mm_r37
		}
	}

	# 38: AI_DYNASTY_PRESTIGE_REASON_LOWBORN
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:secondary_actor = { has_dynasty = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = -20 
			if = {
				limit = { 
					scope:secondary_recipient = { has_dynasty = yes }
				}
				multiply = 6
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_r38
		}
	}

	# 39: AI_DYNASTY_PRESTIGE_REASON_SECONDARY
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:secondary_actor = { has_dynasty = yes }
			scope:recipient.dynasty = scope:secondary_recipient.dynasty
			NOT = { scope:secondary_actor.dynasty = { dynasty_prestige_level = 1 } } 
		}
		add = {
			value = scope:secondary_actor.dynasty.dynasty_prestige_level
			multiply = 5
			subtract = 5 
			desc = aeluran_mm_r39
		}
	}

	# 40: MATRILINEAL_PATRILINEAL_REASON
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				exists = dynasty
				exists = scope:recipient.dynasty
				dynasty = scope:recipient.dynasty
				NAND = {
					dynasty = scope:actor.dynasty
					dynasty = scope:secondary_actor.dynasty
					scope:secondary_actor = { NOT = { has_trait = bastard } }
				}
				scope:recipient = { is_ruler = yes }
				scope:secondary_actor = { sex_opposite_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						NOT = { scope:mm_shepherd = { has_variable = aeluran_bl_matrilineal } }
						is_female = yes
					}
					AND = {
						scope:mm_shepherd = { has_variable = aeluran_bl_matrilineal }
						is_male = yes
					}
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					this = scope:secondary_recipient
					AND = {
						exists = player_heir
						player_heir_position = { 
							value <= 2
							target = scope:secondary_recipient
						}
					}
					has_realm_law = equal_law
					AND = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = { is_female = yes }
						OR = {
							has_realm_law = female_only_law
							has_realm_law = female_preference_law
						}
					}
					AND = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = { is_male = yes }
						OR = {
							has_realm_law = male_only_law
							has_realm_law = male_preference_law
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							this = scope:secondary_recipient
							AND = {
								exists = player_heir
								player_heir_position = {
									value = 0 
									target = scope:secondary_recipient
								}
							}
						}
					}
					OR = {
						AND = {
							scope:recipient.faith = {
								has_doctrine = doctrine_gender_male_dominated
							}
							scope:secondary_recipient = {
								is_male = yes
							}
						}
						AND = {
							scope:recipient.faith = {
								has_doctrine = doctrine_gender_female_dominated
							}
							scope:secondary_recipient = {
								is_female = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
				subtract = 1000
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							this = scope:secondary_recipient
							AND = {
								exists = player_heir
								player_heir_position = {
									value = 0 
									target = scope:secondary_recipient
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				subtract = 100
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						exists = player_heir
						player_heir_position = {
							value = 1 
							target = scope:secondary_recipient
						}
					}
				}
				subtract = 60 
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						exists = player_heir
						player_heir_position = {
							value = 2 
							target = scope:secondary_recipient
						}
					}
				}
				subtract = 30 
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = { has_realm_law = equal_law }
				}
				subtract = 10 
			}
			else = {
				subtract = 20 
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_r40
		}
	}

	# 41: MARRY_DIFFERENT_FAITH_REASON
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:actor = {
						OR = {
							government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic
							government_has_flag = government_is_herder
						}
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					NOR = {
						government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic
						government_has_flag = government_is_herder
						is_tributary_of = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic
							government_has_flag = government_is_herder
						}
					}
				}
				scope:actor = {
					NOR = {
						government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic
						government_has_flag = government_is_herder
						is_tributary_of = scope:recipient
					}
				}
			}
			scope:recipient.faith = {
				faith_hostility_level = {
					target = scope:actor.faith
					value > faith_fully_accepted_level
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = -10
			if = {
				limit = {					
					NOR = {
						is_struggle_parameter_active_interfaith_marriages_available_between_involved_characters_trigger = yes
						AND = {
							has_global_variable = fp2_struggle_conciliation_ending
							fp2_struggle_conciliation_special_cultural_rules_trigger = { C1 = scope:recipient C2 = scope:actor }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:recipient.faith = {
							faith_hostility_level = {
								target = scope:actor.faith
								value > faith_astray_level
							}
						}
					}
					subtract = 15
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:recipient.faith = {
							faith_hostility_level = {
								target = scope:actor.faith
								value >= faith_hostility_prevents_marriage_level
							}
						}
					}
					subtract = 975
				}
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_r41
		}
	}

	# 42: MARRY_DIFFERENT_FAITH_DIVINE_ENDEARMENT_REASON

							faith_hostility_level = {
								target = scope:actor.faith
								value >= faith_hostility_prevents_marriage_level
							}
						}
					}

				}

		}

	# 43: DIVORCE_POLYGAMY

	# 48: MARRY_LOW_FERTILITY_REASON

									count >= 2

								dynasty_prestige_level > 1
							}
						}
					}
					is_ruler = yes
					is_close_or_extended_family_of = scope:recipient
					AND = {
						exists = scope:recipient.player_heir
						this = scope:recipient.player_heir
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_female = no
					effective_age < 45
				}
				any_child = { }
			}
			scope:secondary_actor = {
				is_adult = yes
				OR = {
					fertility < 0.1
					AND = {
						is_female = yes
						effective_age >= marriage_female_fertility_cutoff_age_value
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = -100
			desc = aeluran_mm_r48

	# 53: MARRY_UNIMPORTANT_COURTIER_REASON

	# 54: MARRY_CARES_ABOUT_COURTIER_REASON

				OR = {		
					is_councillor_of = scope:recipient
					has_relation_lover = scope:recipient
					has_relation_soulmate = scope:recipient
					has_relation_friend = scope:recipient
					has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient
					is_knight_of = scope:recipient
					inspiration ?= {

			}
			scope:secondary_actor = { is_married = yes }
			scope:secondary_recipient = { tgp_is_in_ceremonial_house_trigger = yes }
		}
		add = {
			value = -50
			desc = aeluran_mm_r124
		}
	}

	# 125: difficulty_skilled_courtier_block
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_game_rule = hard_difficulty
				has_game_rule = very_hard_difficulty
			}
			scope:actor = {
				is_ai = no
			}
			scope:secondary_actor = {
				NOR = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:actor
					this = scope:actor
				}
			}
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				is_ruler = no
				OR = {
					diplomacy > 12
					stewardship > 12
					martial > 12
					learning > 12
					intrigue > 12
					prowess > 12
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = -2000
			desc = aeluran_mm_r125
		}
	}

	# 126: difficulty_skilled_courtier_block
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_game_rule = hard_difficulty
				has_game_rule = very_hard_difficulty
			}
			scope:actor = {
				is_ai = no
			}
			scope:secondary_actor = {
				OR = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:actor
					this = scope:actor
				}
			}
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				is_ruler = no
				OR = {
					diplomacy > 12
					stewardship > 12
					martial > 12
					learning > 12
					intrigue > 12
					prowess > 12
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = -100
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:secondary_recipient.highest_skill_value >= 20
				}
				add = -50
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_r126
		}
	}

	##################################
	# The Order's own considerations #
	##################################
	add = {
		value = 10
		desc = aeluran_mm_order_will
	}
	# A better-blooded partner than their own
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_actor.genetic_worthiness != scope:secondary_recipient.genetic_worthiness }
		add = {
			value = scope:secondary_actor.genetic_worthiness
			subtract = scope:secondary_recipient.genetic_worthiness
			multiply = 5
			desc = aeluran_mm_blood
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:secondary_actor = { is_ruler = yes is_landed = yes }
		}
		add = {
			value = 10
			desc = aeluran_mm_partner_rules
		}
	}
	# Devotion to the Order
	if = {
		limit = { spiritual_fulfillment >= 30 }
		add = {
			value = 15
			desc = aeluran_mm_devout
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { spiritual_fulfillment <= -30 }
		add = {
			value = -20
			desc = aeluran_mm_wayward
		}
	}
	# The other Matron's regard for the proposer (her flock follows her lead): a liking counts half, a dislike half again
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:mm_matron
			NOT = { scope:mm_matron = scope:mm_shepherd }
		}
		add = {
			value = scope:mm_matron.aeluran_mm_opinion_of_mm_shepherd
			if = {
				limit = { scope:mm_matron.aeluran_mm_opinion_of_mm_shepherd >= 0 }
				multiply = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				multiply = 1.5
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_matron_opinion
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:mm_matron
			NOT = { scope:mm_matron = scope:mm_shepherd }
			scope:mm_matron = {
				OR = {
					has_relation_rival = scope:mm_shepherd
					has_relation_nemesis = scope:mm_shepherd
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = -100
			desc = aeluran_mm_matron_rival
		}
	}
	# Hooks the shepherd chose to use (var list aeluran_bl_hooks on her)
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:mm_shepherd = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = aeluran_bl_hooks target = scope:recipient } }
		}
		add = {
			value = 100
			if = {
				limit = { scope:mm_shepherd = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient } }
				add = 100
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_hook_guardian
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient }
			scope:mm_shepherd = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = aeluran_bl_hooks target = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		}
		add = {
			value = 50
			if = {
				limit = { scope:mm_shepherd = { has_strong_hook = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				add = 50
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_hook_candidate
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:mm_matron
			NOT = { scope:mm_matron = scope:mm_shepherd }
			NOT = { scope:mm_matron = scope:recipient }
			scope:mm_shepherd = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = aeluran_bl_hooks target = scope:mm_matron } }
		}
		add = {
			value = 100
			if = {
				limit = { scope:mm_shepherd = { has_strong_hook = scope:mm_matron } }
				add = 100
			}
			desc = aeluran_mm_hook_matron
		}
	}
}
